name: Hentai Roshutsu Choukyou Tsuma Keiko
original_name: 変態露出調教妻 慶子
source:
It’s been 18 years since we got married.
Keiko, my loyal and devoted wife, is the kind of woman who dedicates herself entirely to her husband—a rare type these days.
Our life together is peaceful, ordinary… and I thought that was what happiness looked like.

But lately, something feels… unfulfilling.
I’ve started to find my dutiful wife… boring.

One day, I confront Keiko and tell her I want a divorce.

Desperate not to lose me, Keiko begs me to stay, pleading with everything she has.
She believes the fault lies entirely with her and is ready to do whatever I ask to make things right.

And now, taking advantage of her vulnerability, my training of Keiko begins…

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cycnonos_pro/keiko/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
我们结婚已经18年了。
惠子，我忠实而忠诚的妻子，是那种把自己完全奉献给丈夫的女人——现在这种类型很少见。
我们在一起的生活平静、平凡……我想这就是幸福的样子。

但最近，有些事情让人感觉……不满足。
我开始发现我尽职的妻子……很无聊。

有一天，我面对惠子并告诉她我想离婚。

惠子不顾一切地不想失去我，恳求我留下来，并用她拥有的一切恳求我。
她认为错误完全在于她，并准备好按照我的要求纠正事情。

现在，利用惠子的脆弱，我对惠子的训练开始了……

[译自[url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cycnonos_pro/keiko/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
